metadata.case_name: WU KIN HO v. WONG KONG HOP KENNETH

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to neck / cervical region
source: There was tenderness over cervical and lumbar region.
Both experts agree that the injury was at soft tissue level and there was no suggestion of any bony damage or neurological deficit.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon at neck level

injuries.description: soft tissue injury to lumbar spine
source: There was tenderness over cervical and lumbar region.
Both experts agree that the injury was at soft tissue level and there was no suggestion of any bony damage or neurological deficit.

Dr Lau opines that although the back pain is not very severe, it could be possible that the plaintiff is still suffering from residual back pain due to soft tissue injury of the plaintiff's lumbar spine.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: pre-existing degeneration of the intervertebral disc at L5/S1 with desiccation changes
source: the intervertebral disc at L5/S1 level loses its normal signal, consistent with desiccation changes.
Both experts also confirmed that the plaintiff suffered from pre-existing degeneration of the intervertebral disc at L5/S1 level.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: disc bulge at L4/5 and L5/S1 levels
source: they are most likely related to his disc bulge at L4/5 and L5/S1 levels rather than the soft tissue injuries sustained by him in the Accident.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: There was tenderness over cervical and lumbar region.
There was no numbness over lower limbs.
The power of 4 limbs was full.
the plaintiff complained on and off back stretching pain provoked by prolonged sitting (1 hour), lifting weight (up to 6 kg) and sleeping (3-4 hours).
genuine pain and discomforts as a result of the soft tissue injuries sustained by him in the Accident
Upon examination, there were minimal objective signs to support.
the present back condition of the plaintiff would have minimal adverse effect on his daily activities.

treatments_received: treatment at Accident & Emergency Department of Pok Oi Hospital
follow-up treatments at hospital and at different out-patient clinics
